institution.name: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)

description_short: The Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST) in Japan seeks a Postdoctoral Researcher for Prof. Ugur Abdulla's Analysis and PDE Unit. Applications are submitted through MathJobs; review starts 1 January 2027, and complete applications received by 28 February 2027 are guaranteed consideration.

deadline.evidence_quote: Review of applications will start on January 1, 2027. For the guaranteed consideration applications must be complete before 11:59 pm on Feb 28, 2027.
